name: bandit.phase4_visibility_road_day_live_mcw
description: Phase-4 live clear-day road row. A real idle camp dispatches an abstract exact pair toward a committed road OMT containing three concrete hostile entities; the production visibility trace must expose its generated remote weather/light, ordinary NPC sight budget, bounded forward acquisition, and observed threat outcome.

steps.label: post_load_phase4_visibility_road_day_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: the daylight road/horde fixture reaches normal gameplay; this is startup footing only
steps.failure_rule: If gameplay does not load, no live visibility proof can be credited.

steps.label: preflight_phase4_visibility_road_day_site
steps.abort_reason: saved state did not contain the idle five-member camp and exact road lead before the visibility run
steps.expected_immediate_state: five ready members and one fixture-known road bounty are idle before production dispatch

steps.label: preflight_phase4_visibility_road_day_horde
steps.abort_reason: saved overmap metadata did not contain three concrete hostile entities on the exact road target OMT
steps.expected_immediate_state: three distinct concrete mon_zombie entities occupy the exact committed target OMT before runtime

steps.label: wait_first_6_hours_toward_phase4_visibility_road_day_due
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: alarm/wait mode menu is visible, then Wait a while is chosen before the 6-hour duration menu
steps.expected_visible_fact: six real game hours pass while production owns legacy migration and initializes the exact camp's routine activation clock
steps.failure_rule: If the first bounded wait does not complete, the deterministic 11-hour dispatch window is not reached.

steps.label: wait_second_6_hours_for_phase4_visibility_road_day_observer
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: alarm/wait mode menu is visible, then Wait a while is chosen before the 6-hour duration menu
steps.expected_visible_fact: the real hourly cadence crosses this camp's deterministic 11-hour due boundary and dispatches an exact pair toward the naturally confirmed road target
steps.failure_rule: If the bounded wait lacks the exact dispatch artifact, the row is red/inconclusive.

steps.label: wait_first_1_hour_for_phase4_visibility_road_day_approach
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: alarm/wait mode menu is visible, then Wait a while is chosen before the 1-hour duration menu
steps.expected_visible_fact: the first real post-dispatch hour advances the pair to its canonical approach OMT and begins stalking toward the selected exact watch; approach and watch arrival are intentionally separate owner transitions
steps.failure_rule: If the first bounded post-dispatch wait does not reach scheduler hour 156 at minute 9360, the serialized approach transition is red/inconclusive.

steps.label: wait_second_1_hour_for_phase4_visibility_road_day_observer
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: alarm/wait mode menu is visible, then Wait a while is chosen before the 1-hour duration menu
steps.expected_visible_fact: the second real post-dispatch hour reaches the selected exact watch and runs the production structural visibility read before the exact road-target audit
steps.failure_rule: If the second bounded post-dispatch wait lacks a visibility artifact at scheduler hour 157 and minute 9420, the row is red/inconclusive.

steps.label: audit_phase4_visibility_road_day_artifact
steps.abort_reason: same-run debug delta did not prove the exact clear-weather three-point no-optic budget, bounded forward acquisition, and concrete threat observation on the exact road target
steps.failure_rule: No day-row credit if dispatch, exact clear-weather visibility inputs, and exact visibility outcome are not present on same-run lines.

steps.label: audit_phase4_visibility_road_day_no_fixture_optic
steps.abort_reason: the no-optic road fixture produced an optical visibility trace
steps.failure_rule: Unexpected optics invalidate this ordinary-day contrast.

evidence_contract.claim: a real abstract exact pair uses ordinary clear-day production visibility to acquire three concrete hostile entities only on its one-OMT committed forward road target, with no fixture optic or player-coordinate input
evidence_contract.load_only_verdict: load/setup proof only / inconclusive for structural visibility
evidence_contract.failure_rule: No Phase-4 day-row credit unless startup, exact idle site/lead, exact three-entity target footing, elapsed production dispatch, bounded observer inputs, forward acquisition, observed threat outcome, and no-optic control are separately green.
